text:
Historical findings CASEID FILE NOTE
1) Domain context: A records office maintains intake ledgers with standard fields for applicant identifiers, filing dates, and status codes. Entries are logged sequentially, cross-referenced against supporting documents, and archived upon processing. No intake facts are recorded in this section.
2) What occurred: The actor entered a marriage petition form (I-130) with a spouse field listing a named individual, while the payment field for the spousal relationship remained unverified. The actor attached a joint lease document dated prior to the filing date, with the occupancy field showing the named individual, while the utility provider field stayed unverified. The actor submitted bank statements from a named account showing recurring transfers, with the transfer purpose field blank and the counterparty identity unverified. The actor uploaded photos of the named individual at a shared address to the photo evidence field, with the capture date metadata unverified. The actor filed an affidavit of cohabitation from the named individual, with the signing field dated but the notary seal field unverified. The actor recorded interview notes in the case file, with the coaching content field unverified and the session dates unverified. The actor added a note to the payment concealment field regarding officer interactions, with the disclosure status field unverified.
3) Materials/access observed: The actor accessed the petition form I-130, the joint lease document, bank statements from a named account, photo evidence files, the affidavit of cohabitation, interview notes, and the case file note field. The actor used the online filing portal and email channel to submit the documents and communicate with the named individual.
4) Indicators & artifacts: The petition form showed a spouse field with a named individual but no marriage certificate attachment field completed. The joint lease document had an occupancy field listing the named individual without a corresponding utility account field. The bank statements showed recurring transfers with a blank transfer purpose field. The photo evidence files had unverified capture date metadata. The affidavit of cohabitation had a dated signing field with an unverified notary seal field. The interview notes contained unverified coaching content and session dates. The case file note field contained unverified disclosure status content.
